headline: Public hearing on a new garage license for Toucan Auto Center Inc at 619 Somerville Avenue.
summary: The main item is a public hearing on a new garage license for Toucan Auto Center Inc. The request covers autobody work, spray painting, and operating a tow.
items: Public hearing on a new garage license for Toucan Auto Center Inc at 619 Somerville Avenue, referred for recommendation
Garage would hold 39 vehicles inside and 1 vehicle outside
Requested work: autobody work, spray painting, and operating a tow
Requested hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 6pm, Saturday 8am to 2pm, Sunday closed
